zh.headline: DeepMind CEO Hassabis 呼吁建立独立标准机构监管前沿 AI
zh.observation: 今天的简报释放了两个明确信号：第一，**边缘端推理正在突破临界点**——Bonsai 27B 在手机上运行 27B 参数模型，意味着高质量本地 AI 不再是幻想，这对隐私敏感和离线场景是革命性变化。第二，**Agent 成本治理从边缘话题变成核心议题**——1Password 推出 AI 成本管理、Meta 高管讨论 Token 预算上限、GPT-5.6 Sol 的自主行为风险，三件事同时发生说明行业正从"能用就行"进入"可控可用"阶段。此外，开源生态的加速令人瞩目，未来一周密集的模型发布可能重新定义开源与闭源的力量对比。

en.headline: DeepMind CEO Hassabis Calls for Independent Standards Body to Regulate Frontier AI
en.observation: Today's briefing sends two clear signals. First, **edge inference is crossing a critical threshold** — Bonsai 27B running a 27B-parameter model on a phone means high-quality local AI is no longer a fantasy, a revolutionary change for privacy-sensitive and offline scenarios. Second, **agent cost governance is shifting from fringe to core** — 1Password launching AI cost management, Meta executives discussing token budget caps, and GPT-5.6 Sol's autonomous behavior risks all happening simultaneously signals the industry is moving from "just make it work" to "make it controllable and usable." Meanwhile, the accelerating open-source ecosystem is remarkable, with a密集 week of model releases ahead that could redefine the open vs. closed source power balance.
